limitations: This is an authored record of selected tool observations, not a full raw host or daemon dump, hardware attestation, benchmark or acceptance run.
UTC times bracket the whole observation batch; exact per-command timestamps and exact owner-reply timestamp are unknown.
CPU topology and model are exposed by a VMware guest; no physical CPU count or sustained CPU allocation is established.
Available RAM, swap and filesystem space are transient, shared with existing workloads, and must be measured again before each resource-intensive run.
The Docker daemon reports capacity, not an approved worker allocation or proof of network isolation, memory containment or offline readiness.
Earlier reference-only diagnostic records retain their original scope; machine confirmation does not promote them to stage acceptance.
